arsenic contamination in soil may affect the processing quality of different potato cultivars.
As concentration in the potato soil reduced the quality parameters (DM and starch concentration) of the potato cultivar, but had no effect on SG and TTS.
As contamination of the soil reduced the DM and the starch concentration in potato tubers, while it had no significant effects of the SG and TSS of the tubers.
